_note: Payment routes the wallet can rank. Every fee and reward figure cites a source with the time it was read. Figures marked 'inferred' or 'unverified' are shown but never counted in the ranking. Sources were read by Claude through a web fetch on 2026-10-02; a person should re-open each URL and confirm before the demo.

src_tng_single_use_card.title: PCCW/HKT press release: Tap & Go Single Use Card (23 July 2026)
src_tng_single_use_card.quote: each card is issued with a unique card number, expiry date and CVV. After one successful payment, these credentials will immediately expire ... maximum: HK$2,000 ... validity period of no longer than two months ... Virtual Mastercard Prepaid Card

src_tng_charges.title: Tap & Go service charges (page last updated 14 September 2026)
src_tng_charges.quote: Annual Fee: Free; Top-up Non-cash: Free; Local and Foreign Transaction (Settled in foreign currency): MasterCard charge 2%, UnionPay charge 1%; Foreign Transaction (Settled in HK$): 1%

src_hsbc_red_rebate.title: HSBC Red Credit Card product page
src_hsbc_red_rebate.quote: Earn 4% RewardCash (RC) on the first HKD10,000 you spend online and unlimited 0.4% RC on subsequent online spending each calendar month ... Perpetual annual fee waiver

src_hsbc_rewardcash_value.title: HSBC RewardCash redemption
src_hsbc_rewardcash_value.quote: Every $1 RewardCash can be used to offset HKD1 on your spending

src_hsbc_fps.title: HSBC Faster Payment System (FPS) page
src_hsbc_fps.quote: No charges for HKD and RMB transfers ... other banks may have different charging policies

src_hkicl_fps_faq.title: HKICL FPS consumer FAQ
src_hkicl_fps_faq.quote: Customers may set limits in their direct debit authorizations to different parties.

routes.label: Tap & Go Single Use Card
routes.instrument: Virtual prepaid Mastercard, one payment per card number
routes.settlement: card authorisation now, capture at checkout

fee.note: The fee table lists charges only for foreign-currency and foreign transactions; nothing is listed for a local HKD purchase.

reward.note: Neither source lists a reward for Single Use Card spending.

routes.label: HSBC Red credit card (scoped network token)
routes.network_note: Card scheme not confirmed from the issuer page; check the card face before claiming Mastercard.
routes.instrument: Caregiver's credit card, tokenised per purchase and locked to one merchant, amount and expiry
routes.settlement: card authorisation now, capture at checkout

fee.note: Annual fee waived; no charge listed for a local HKD purchase.

routes.label: FPS direct debit (eDDA)
routes.instrument: Bank account debit under an eDDA authorisation with its own limit
routes.settlement: instant credit transfer at checkout; no hold, so the reservation lives only in the wallet ledger

fee.note: HSBC charges nothing for HKD FPS transfers; other banks may differ.
